comparison_plan.overall_reasoning: Compare the three numerical metagene columns because the task evaluates W activation scores. Exclude Sample_ID, which serves only for row alignment, and omit TumorNormalGroup because it is descriptive metadata outside the stated evaluation target. Allow component names and order to differ by testing all six global one-to-one mappings of candidate components to reference components; the same mapping must apply to all 90 samples. No categorical overlap comparison or delimiter is needed. The displayed rows appear consistent with rounding differences, but the remaining rows must also be checked.

comparison_plan.overall_reasoning: All 100 gene columns are equally critical float64 NMF loadings. Exclude metagene from comparison and use it only for alignment; align gene columns by name, ignoring their order. Respect the supplied row alignment; if component correspondence remains ambiguous, evaluate the six possible one-to-one permutations of the three metagene rows using one shared permutation across all genes. Compare each loading directly with RAE = abs(candidate-reference)/abs(reference) and cell_tolerance=0.05, as explicitly required. For zero references, define zero versus zero as matching and any nonzero candidate as failing. Require all 300 cells to pass, equivalent to a thresholded match fraction of 1.0 for every gene column. Require finite, nonnegative loadings and treat missing or nonfinite values as failures. Do not normalize, rescale, or log-transform these output loadings again. Correlation would not enforce the required magnitude agreement. Categorical delimiters and Jaccard thresholds are inapplicable.
